newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-EUROPEAN CUP DEAL AGREED BY BSKYB.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-EUROPEAN CUP DEAL AGREED BY BSKYB.

text.p: British Sky Broadcasting said on Friday it had secured the rights to broadcast rugby union's European Cup for the next five years.
BSkyB, partly owned by Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd, did not disclose the terms of the agreement which will guarantee coverage of the tournament, won this year by French club Brive, until 2002.
"Interest in club rugby has never been higher," BSkyB said in a statement.
